pairs.why: The two fans are almost pixel-identical in shape, red satin finish, gold ribs and soft light, so neither is clearly closer to the real purple fan.
B's folds look a touch smoother and less crisply textured, closer to the soft matte-satin finish of the real scarf and fan, but the difference is marginal.
A has a brighter rim highlight along the top edge that reads slightly glossier and more 'rendered', while B's softer even satin sheen sits closer to the real cards.
Both fans are essentially identical in construction, color and lighting, with no meaningful difference against the real cards.
A's top edge has a slightly sharper, shinier highlight, while B's smoother cloth shading is a hair nearer the real fan's soft finish.
A's folds have slightly rounder, softer volume like the puffy real scarf, while B's edges read marginally crisper, though the gap is very small.
B's top edge is slightly wavier and more irregular, while A's cleaner, evenly pleated silhouette better matches the tidy real fan.
A's slightly larger, softer, rounder pleats with a gentle satin sheen match the plush, smooth-but-not-plastic real cards a little better than B's flatter, tighter folds.
